description: This PHP class 'SubscriptionDashboardController' manages user subscription dashboard functionalities, including viewing and canceling subscriptions, integrating with Stripe API, and rendering views with sidebar menu creation.

classes.name: SubscriptionDashboardController
classes.description: Controller for managing user subscription dashboard, including viewing and canceling subscriptions, with Stripe API integration.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Creates sidebar menu entries based on section and zone, for dashboard navigation.

methods.name: getSubscriptionData
methods.description: Retrieves detailed subscription data including product info from Stripe.

methods.name: viewAction
methods.description: Handles displaying a specific subscription's details.

methods.name: cancelAction
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a subscription, including form processing and Stripe API call.
